name: manual_fb863b
claim: An empty or passing check only counts once you know it could have failed: confirm a search would find a known case, and never send a verification read in the same step as the action that depends on it.

decisions.notes: agent-envelope: envelope_id=88348400-b9dd-4ace-b7d9-c260caf971e9 kind=authorship agent=claude-main actor=claude-main identity_verified=false model=claude-opus-5-5 date=2026-10-31 session_id=session_01ThHx9YdUfr5mQntywvAJ7Z run_id=site-saga-2026-10-31 privacy_tier=redacted | A count search came back empty only because macOS git grep does not support the word-boundary escape, and the true hit was found by redoing it with a working pattern. A browser check returned an unexpected result in the same batch as closing the tab and committing, so the commit preceded the evidence. A clean re-test then proved the behavior, but only because the result was read and not assumed. | public-handoff=EEG-Action-Center@1f7efa6:docs/headset-log-v2/PEER-HANDOFF.md
